data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Yandex SmartCaptcha on Android, iOS, and web.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Yandex SmartCaptcha into Flutter applications using native WebViews on mobile and DOM elements with JavaScript interop on the web. Exposes a streamlined API for captcha configuration, execution, resetting, and lifecycle callbacks.
use_when: You need to protect your Flutter mobile or web app with Yandex SmartCaptcha.
You want an easy way to handle captcha challenges and receive verification tokens.
avoid_when: You require a non-Yandex captcha provider like Google reCAPTCHA or hCaptcha.
You are running in an environment without WebView support on mobile platforms.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and web (including WebAssembly).
Provides both declarative widget configuration and an imperative controller for execution and resetting.
Automatically injects the Yandex script on the web so manual index.html modifications are not required.
weaknesses: Dependent on platform-specific WebView implementations on mobile.
Some configuration parameters are ignored on web.
data.setup_notes: Requires a client key from Yandex SmartCaptcha. No manual index.html script injection is required for web.
